test_title: SSC Selection Post 2025 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 28 Jul, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Choose the correct one-word substitution for:**"A child born after the death of their father ___."**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Posthumous**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"Posthumous"** refers to something that occurs or is awarded after the death of the person concerned. (मरणोपरांत)
 
 
• **Example:** The author received a posthumous award for his contributions to literature.
 
 
• **"Posthumous"** is the correct word to describe a child born after the death of their father. (मरणोपरांत)
 
 
• **Example:** He was a posthumous child, born two months after his father's death.
